builder.label: Build your own set
builder.help: The page where customers pick any pieces of a set group and the set price applies by itself ("Any 2 polos ৳X · Any 3 ৳Y"). The prices and the groups are your set tier rules in Smart Rules; this only opens the page. on: customers can use it (off until you turn it on; while off the page says it is taking a break and shows your ready-made sets). rules: which set tier rules it offers, by their key (empty = every live one). categories: only products of these categories show (empty = every category the rules cover). maxStyles: the most styles one group shows. perItem: "৳X per item" under each set price. entries: the "Build your own" row on the sets page and the link beside "More sets".
